subject: AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
text:
U1047/26 NOTAMR U0649/26 Q) UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03617E999 A) UUUU  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2608150538  C) 2611152359 EST  E) AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
OF AUSTRIA, STIPULATING THAT ALL RUSSIAN REGISTERED ACFT AND
ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS
OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR BY OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR
CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE
PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY AUSTRIAN AIRSPACE EXCEPT FOR
HUMANITARIAN, SAR AND LEASED ACFT ONE-WAY RETURN FLIGHTS WITH THE
PERMISSION OF THE APPROPRIATE AUSTRIAN AUTHORITIES AND CASES
OF EMERGENCY LANDING OR EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT, SUP 011/26,
THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM OF
THE PROHIBITION OF FLIGHT OPERATIONS WI AIRSPACE OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION TO ALL AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN THE REPUBLIC OF AUSTRIA
AND ALL ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL
PERSONS FROM THE REPUBLIC OF AUSTRIA OR BY OPERATORS HOLDING AOC
ISSUED BY THE REPUBLIC OF AUSTRIA, WIE UNTIL 2359 UTC 15.11.2026
EST, EXCEPT FOR HUMANITARIAN, SAR, LEASED AIRCRAFT ONE-WAY RETURN
FLIGHTS WITH PERMISSION OF THE RELEVANT AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION, CASES OF EMERGENCY LANDING OR EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT,
AS WELL AS IN CASES WHEN A END PART 1 OF 2
U1047/26 NOTAMR U0649/26 Q) UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03617E999 A) UUUU  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2608150538  C) 2611152359 EST  E) SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLIGHT OPERATIONS
IS GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR THE MINISTRY OF
FOREGN AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE. END PART 2 OF 2
